activities.reading_passage:
Hello neighbours,

Last summer, several vegetables struggled during the hottest weeks, even though volunteers watered them every afternoon. A local gardener explained that much of the water was evaporating before it reached the roots. We therefore propose watering early in the morning on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, with an extra check on particularly hot days. This should save water without neglecting the plants.

Please reply by Thursday if you can help with a morning shift. We will review the plan after one month.

Best wishes,
The Garden Committee

activities.title: The missing poster
activities.learning_objective: Interpret and use appropriate intermediate English
activities.instructions: Read or listen carefully and answer.
activities.content: Read a short story about resolving a misunderstanding.
activities.question: What does the story suggest about making assumptions?
accepted_answers_json: It is better to check facts before judging someone's motives.
activities.explanation: Nina thinks the poster was removed deliberately, but later learns it was moved to keep it dry.
activities.feedback_correct: Correct. Review why this answer fits.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Check the context and try again.
activities.option_c: A missing object must have been stolen.
activities.option_d: It is better to check facts before judging someone's motives.
activities.story_text:
Nina had spent three evenings designing a poster for the school concert. On Monday morning, she hurried to the noticeboard, hoping to see it beside the main entrance. The poster was missing.

She immediately suspected Leo, who had argued that the concert needed a different design. Nina avoided him throughout the morning. At lunchtime, their teacher asked why she looked upset. After listening, the teacher opened a cupboard and showed Nina the poster.

Rain had blown through an open window on Friday. Leo had noticed the paper getting wet and placed it safely in the cupboard before leaving. He had forgotten to tell anyone.

Nina felt embarrassed. She thanked Leo and apologised for assuming the worst. Together they put the poster back, this time behind a clear plastic cover.
